name: FUTURE
aliases: Female Urgency, Trial of Urodynamics as Routine Evaluation
question: Does adding invasive urodynamics to comprehensive clinical assessment improve patient-reported success before invasive treatment for refractory overactive bladder symptoms in women?

design.population: Women with refractory overactive bladder or urgency-predominant mixed urinary incontinence after conservative and pharmacological treatment, considering invasive treatment.
design.locator: Lancet 2025 pp1058–1059, Methods and trial profile

verdictNote: Added urodynamics did not improve final patient-reported success.
takeaway: In women considering invasive treatment for refractory overactive bladder symptoms, urodynamics plus comprehensive clinical assessment did not improve final patient-reported success versus comprehensive clinical assessment alone (23.6% versus 22.7%; adjusted OR 1.12, 95% CI 0.73–1.74).
